scope: Read-only unused equipment and asset inventory; no activation, deletion, rendering or new engine test.

classification_definitions.ready candidate: A usable candidate is present, with an identifiable purpose; later visual/audio and integration review still required. This is not approval to ship.
classification_definitions.needs integration: Useful pieces exist, but required prototype, gameplay, rendering or recipe wiring is missing.
classification_definitions.historical or superseded: Duplicate, replaced, deliberately disconnected, older iteration or source/backup material. Preserve until a separate decision.
classification_definitions.uncertain: File exists, but its target, provenance or suitability is insufficiently established for a stronger reuse recommendation.

method: Recursively scanned all strings in the existing final data.raw dump, including dynamically assembled/shared sprite paths.
Protected literal media paths from reachable current Lua data and runtime entry points; optional official compatibility branches are included conservatively.
Verified all 514 current runtime media files match the 1.8.101 source bytes.
Recorded PNG dimensions from headers and SHA-256 identities; no visual render or audio audition.
Used git tree metadata and existing production/provenance documents for sparse-excluded art sources; no bulk source-art download.
Excluded recycling-only outputs from normal item acquisition; excluded automatic migration files from dormant require analysis.
limitations: No-active-reference-found is a bounded current-source finding, not permission to delete a file or remove a prototype ID.
Historical saves, external mods/scenarios and future authoring use were not exhaustively searched.
Actual engine observations belong to 1.8.101; the concurrent 1.8.102 changes were inspected statically and were not retested by this inventory.
Sparse model and third-party binary files were catalogued from git metadata and documentation, not visually inspected.

equipment_and_helper_orphans.name: modular-tank
equipment_and_helper_orphans.state: Registered but not normally obtainable; no non-recycling producer, recipe unlock or component consumer.
available: Inherited vanilla medium-equipment-grid (6 by 8, armor category)
missing: Balance decision and any desired distinct icon
equipment_and_helper_orphans.recommendation: Preserve the ID. Treat as a candidate early dual-gun platform only after a separate design decision.

equipment_and_helper_orphans.name: tank-artillery
equipment_and_helper_orphans.state: Registered but not crafted or mounted; every loaded field except name equals tank-nade-cannon.
missing: Distinct artillery behavior or gameplay role
equipment_and_helper_orphans.recommendation: Preserve as a possible legacy alias. Reuse the existing mounted mortar gun unless a distinct feature is designed; the name alone does not provide artillery targeting.

equipment_and_helper_orphans.name: tank-recall-token
equipment_and_helper_orphans.state: Registered capsule and visual effect prototypes, but no recipe or tank-recall technology; relevant event hooks are commented out.
missing: Working teleport and vehicle/player state lifecycle
Recipe, research and intended gameplay role
equipment_and_helper_orphans.recommendation: Keep dormant. Restoration is a separate runtime feature, not an asset activation.

equipment_and_helper_orphans.name: massive-scorchmark
equipment_and_helper_orphans.state: Loaded helper with no active incoming use. Projectile comments explicitly avoid it because extra corpse scorchmarks caused square-block artifacts.
equipment_and_helper_orphans.recommendation: Preserve the existing unused ID; do not reconnect it as an automatic nuclear-effect improvement.

equipment_and_helper_orphans.name: lazer-cloud
equipment_and_helper_orphans.state: Loaded helper with no active incoming use; referenced only in a commented projectile alternative beside the current poison cloud.
equipment_and_helper_orphans.recommendation: Treat as an old effect sketch. Its declared laser-damage data is not proof of a working current cloud weapon; prototype behavior and consumer would need review.

unreferenced_runtime_assets.assessment: No active consumer or documented current destination identified; inspect provenance and visual fit before selecting a target.
